meta.title: Sniffy — See your traffic. Control every request.
meta.description: Sniffy is an open-source, cross-platform proxy and debugging tool. Inspect HTTP / HTTPS traffic, resend requests, rewrite responses, and script your own workflow with JavaScript plugins. Runs on the desktop or headless.
meta.ogTitle: Sniffy — See your traffic. Control every request.
meta.ogDescription: Open source, cross-platform, scriptable. A network debugging workbench built for developers.

features.title: Follow the request. Find the answer.

capture.title: Every detail, in view.
capture.text: Find a slow request. Open its headers and body. Follow HTTP traffic, WebSocket conversations, and streaming messages in one place.
capture.label: OBSERVE

debug.title: Step in where it matters.
debug.text: Match conditions and apply actions automatically with rules. Set a request or response breakpoint to edit traffic before forwarding it.
debug.label: INTERCEPT

plugins.title: Your logic. Applied live.
plugins.text: Write mocks and rewrites as JavaScript plugins. Save to reload, and let the next request follow your rules.
plugins.label: VERIFY

signing.label: Sign a request
signing.note: Change the order amount and send again. When the body changes, the signature changes too.

mock.label: Simulate failures
mock.note: Switch the response status to reproduce an expired session or a service outage.

token.label: Relay a token
token.note: Extract a token from the sample login response and carry it into the next request.
